title: H^n of a ball in the span of an orthonormal n-frame equals ω_n ρ^n
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every orthonormal family τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) in ℝ^P := Euclid P (Orthonormal ℝ τ) with Q := span{τ_1, …, τ_n}, every y ∈ Q and every ρ > 0: H^n(B_ρ(y) ∩ Q) = ω_n·ρ^n, where H^n := μHE[n] (the normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P), ω_n := unitBallVolume n (the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of Euclid n) and ρ^n is read as ofReal(ρ^n) in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ), ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μHE[n] (ball y ρ ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
